caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical vase or container with a slightly flared rim and flat base. The vase is entirely covered with a mottled pattern in shades of reddish-brown and darker brown, with lighter yellowish and gold specks distributed unevenly across the surface, giving it a textured appearance. The vase is placed against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the name "Fritz Boehmer" appears in small printed letters. The lighting in the drawing creates subtle highlights and shadows on the vase, accentuating its three-dimensional form.
title: Pickle Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
